news.title: Erling Haaland sues Norwegian Air over World Cup ad featuring his ponytail
news.lede: Norway football star Erling Haaland has taken legal action against Norwegian Air Shuttle, alleging that the airline used elements of his appearance without permission in a World Cup advertisement. The dispute centres on a social media post released during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, when Norway made its first appearance at the tournament since 1998. According to Norwegian newspaper Verdens Gang (VG), the airline shared a composite image of one of its aircraft featuring a ponytail resembling Haaland's distinctive hairstyle. The post carried the caption, "We've never looked more Norwegian," referencing the national team's World Cup campaign.

news.title: Infantino set to take his FIFA re-election campaign to Japan to court Asian football federations
news.lede: AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/qq6782/article71603543.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/Infantino_In_Japan_Soccer_26543.jpg Beata Zawrzel FILE -FIFA President Gianni Infantino arrives to attend the opening game of the Women's U20 World Cup opening match between Poland and Argentina in Katowice, Poland, Saturday, Sept. (AP Photo/Beata Zawrzel, File) The AFC had joined the criticism of Infantino in the wake of the proposed World Cup sell-off, but its members appear far from united. Tokyo Gianni Infantino’s campaign for re-election as FIFA president is set to move this week to Japan and a meeting scheduled for Wednesday with the Asian Football Confederation. This comes after Infantino apologised last week in Zurich, Switzerland, to FIFA’s 37-member ruling council — which he chairs — for “mistakes” he made in assembling a now-scrapped $4.2 billion sell-off plan for the World Cup.

news.title: FIFA suspends Egypt coach Hossam Hassan and Zico for referee criticism after World Cup exit
news.lede: FIFA bans Egypt head coach Hossam Hassan and Mostafa Zico after referee criticism following World Cup exit to Argentina.
